summary_md: **Small Fish ([@SmallFishes777](https://x.com/SmallFishes777/status/2115072819604443151))** announces **deepseek-memory**, an open-source long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness with persistent memory, project context across sessions and automatic consolidation; the repo describes curated two-tier plain-file memory.
